explanation.label: What it does
explanation.text: This flow reads the health findings of one CortexKit module, chosen when the flow is set up, whenever that module reports that its findings changed, and every six hours in case a report is missed. It wakes the agent that owns that module only when a finding is new, gets worse, or grows by half, and at most once in four hours for the same finding. It reads the findings and writes nothing. It exists so that a module's owner learns about slow queries, stuck work or errors without checking by hand.

facts.label: Runs as
facts.value: This flow runs as each agent whose persona lists it. Agent-scoped grants apply to this agent's own data only.
